Treating them as mutually exclusive doesn't capture how I actually work—or how effective analysis generally is. Both have strengths and limitations.

If you're pushing for a specific orientation, I find it more meaningful to explore *why* certain approaches tend to dominate in particular domains rather than declaring one universal winner.
